name: Kagurazaka Mioko
source:
She has called Mikoto “Miss” since she was a child, and is her personal and public servant. She is not immune to men and seems to be a germaphobe.

She wishes for Mikoto's happiness more than anyone else, and is satisfied as long as Mikoto is happy.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
